title: Telling the band he hated the commercial music, Nat's challenge
summary: Sam tells the Columbus audience how he felt, wants to be a creative musician, and Nat invites him to fight.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: You know, it's all right to make, if you, okay, want to make a commercial record. B ut if, we come to find out man, that we could play all night, with nothing but commercial songs man, you know. I'd played in the key of F so much I had a groove, man, in my fingerboard, where F is, you know.

And I just couldn't take it, and I went out in the concert in Columbus, and I told them just how I felt, you know, and uhm, of course, they's feelings was hurt, But man, they don't know how long my feelings have been hurt.
Because I am involved with this stuff, man, you know what I mean.

And I didn't want to be involved with this commercial type because that's what, not where I came from. I felt man, that I wanted to be, I always wanted to be from a child up, I wanted to be a creative musician.

And uhm, I don't hear this commercial stuff and I don't want to be involved in it in the first place, so I let them know that I don't like it and I don't want to be involved with it and uh, this uh, Nat, he even invited me outside, he wanted to fight me because I said what I said, but I said I had to be truthful to myself, man. If you can't be truthful to yourself, then who, what the hell.
So that's the way, his feelings was hurt, I can't help that you know.
Uhm, that's the way I felt.
Uhm, so that, that really got uptight, but well, how did Cannon take it? I mean...
He was really hurt, I didn't care man.
I told him how I felt about it man.
